'''Christophe Galfard''' (born 1976 in Paris, France) is a French [[physicist]] and writer.<ref>{{Cite web |date=4 March 2016 |title=Christophe Galfard – L'autre Livre |url=http://www.lautrelivre.fr/christophe-galfard/ |access-date=2022-10-09 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160304042805/http://www.lautrelivre.fr/christophe-galfard/ |archive-date=2016-03-04 }}</ref>

== Biography ==
After graduating from the [[École Centrale Paris]] in 1999 and specializing in [[theoretical physics]],<ref>{{Cite web |date=24 September 2015 |title=Christophe Galfard – 28 minutes {{!}} Christophe Galfard {{!}} 28 minutes, du lundi au vendredi à 20h05 {{!}} Monde {{!}} fr – ARTE |url=http://www.arte.tv/fr/christophe-galfard-28-minutes/6728538,CmC=6728548.html |access-date=2022-10-09 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150924044026/http://www.arte.tv/fr/christophe-galfard-28-minutes/6728538,CmC=6728548.html |archive-date=2015-09-24 }}</ref> he then obtained a PhD at the [[University of Cambridge]] under the supervision of [[Stephen Hawking]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=13 October 2020 |title=À propos – Site Officiel de Christophe Galfard |url=https://www.christophegalfard.fr/a-propos/ |access-date=2022-10-09 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201013123304/https://www.christophegalfard.fr/a-propos/ |archive-date=2020-10-13 }}</ref> He co-published with the latter and [[Lucy Hawking]] ''George and the Secrets of the Universe'' in 2007.

He then published the ''Prince of Clouds'' novel trilogy with ''Le Blueberry'' (2009), ''Le Matin des trois soleils'' (2012) and ''La Colère du ciel et du vent'' (2013). In 2015, he published ''The Universe in Your Hand''.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Christophe Galfard – Tous les livres |url=http://www4.fnac.com/Christophe-Galfard/ia800802 |website=Fnac}}</ref>
